title: Is Palindrome
description: Write a function that checks if a string is a palindrome. A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards. For example, 'racecar' and 'madam' are palindromes, but 'hello' is not.
instructions: Complete the is_palindrome function so it returns True if the string is a palindrome and False if it is not.
expected_behavior: is_palindrome('racecar') -> True, is_palindrome('hello') -> False, is_palindrome('madam') -> True, is_palindrome('a') -> True
hints: Think about how you would compare the string to its reverse.
In Python you can reverse a string using slicing: s[::-1]
Compare the original string to the reversed version — if they match, it's a palindrome.
